commands: # 0. same-tree export + input sets (final official run; scan tree = 78d3ed5cf5, clean)

git archive HEAD | tar -x -C /tmp/j2f-export
git ls-files | LC_ALL=C sort > /tmp/j2f/tracked.txt   # 6582 paths

git ls-tree -r -l HEAD | awk 'tolower($5) !~ /(^|\/)(\.bzr|\.bzrignore|\.git|\.gitignore|\.gitattributes|\.hg|\.hgignore|\.repo|\.svn|\.svnignore|\.tfignore|vssver\.scc|cvs|\.cvsignore)$/ {print $5}' | LC_ALL=C sort > /tmp/j2f/expected.txt   # 6574 (VCS-filtered; workflow-identical filter)
# 1. full scan (baseline)

cd /tmp/j2f-export && /usr/bin/time -v /tmp/j1-venv/bin/scancode --license --copyright --processes 4 --json-pp /tmp/j2f/full.json .   # exit 0; 7226 entries (6574 files + 652 dirs); wall 8m33.63s; paths emitted as j2f-export/<rel> (cwd-basename quirk, spec §5)
# 2. deterministic size-greedy shard split (workflow semantics)

for s in 0 1; do git ls-tree -r -l HEAD | awk 'tolower($5) !~ /<same VCS filter>/ {print $4, $5}' | LC_ALL=C sort -k1,1rn -k2,2 | awk -v s="$s" 'BEGIN{w0=0; w1=0} { if (w0 <= w1) { w0 += $1; t=0 } else { w1 += $1; t=1 } if (t == s) print $2 }' | LC_ALL=C sort > /tmp/j2f/shard$s.txt; done   # 3250 / 3324 paths; 42,822,954 / 42,822,953 bytes
# 3. shard legs: staged single-root scans (run in parallel; 4 processes each)
for s in 0 1; do rm -rf /tmp/j2f/stage$s && mkdir -p /tmp/j2f/stage$s/j2-export; done
tar -C /tmp/j2f-export -cf - -T /tmp/j2f/shard0.txt | tar -C /tmp/j2f/stage0/j2-export -xf -
tar -C /tmp/j2f-export -cf - -T /tmp/j2f/shard1.txt | tar -C /tmp/j2f/stage1/j2-export -xf -
cd /tmp/j2f/stage0 && /tmp/j1-venv/bin/scancode --license --copyright --processes 4 --json-pp /tmp/j2f/shard0.json j2-export   # exit 0; wall 289.37s; 3250 files + 535 dirs
cd /tmp/j2f/stage1 && /tmp/j1-venv/bin/scancode --license --copyright --processes 4 --json-pp /tmp/j2f/shard1.json j2-export   # exit 0; wall 315.22s; 3324 files + 534 dirs
# 4. per-leg set self-check (workflow semantics): input list == emitted file-path set
jq -r '.files[] | select(.type=="file") | .path' /tmp/j2f/shard0.json | sed 's|^j2-export/||' | LC_ALL=C sort | LC_ALL=C comm -3 /tmp/j2f/shard0.txt - | wc -l   # 0
jq -r '.files[] | select(.type=="file") | .path' /tmp/j2f/shard1.json | sed 's|^j2-export/||' | LC_ALL=C sort | LC_ALL=C comm -3 /tmp/j2f/shard1.txt - | wc -l   # 0
# 5. merge (workflow jq expression verbatim, incl. dedup)

jq -s '{headers: .[0].headers, files: (map(.files) | add | sort_by(.path) | group_by(.path) | map(.[0])), license_detections: (map(.license_detections) | add | group_by(.identifier) | map(.[0] + {detection_count: (map(.detection_count) | add)}))}' /tmp/j2f/shard0.json /tmp/j2f/shard1.json > /tmp/j2f/merged.json   # deterministic: re-run produced sha256-identical output
# 6. set completeness (workflow semantics; expected = VCS-filtered ls-tree set)
jq -r '.files[] | select(.type=="file") | .path' /tmp/j2f/merged.json | sed 's|^j2-export/||' | LC_ALL=C sort > /tmp/j2f/merged_paths.txt
jq -r '.files[] | select(.type=="file") | .path' /tmp/j2f/full.json | sed 's|^j2f-export/||' | LC_ALL=C sort > /tmp/j2f/full_paths.txt
LC_ALL=C comm -3 /tmp/j2f/expected.txt /tmp/j2f/merged_paths.txt | wc -l   # 0
LC_ALL=C comm -3 /tmp/j2f/expected.txt /tmp/j2f/full_paths.txt | wc -l     # 0
# 7. evaluator double run (binary compiled once in J1: nim c --hints:off --warnings:off --path:. --path:src -o:/tmp/j1/vsi_license_eval tools/ci/publication_license_eval.nim)

/tmp/j1/vsi_license_eval --scan /tmp/j2f/full.json --policy compliance/policy/license-policy.yml --origin compliance/provenance/source-origin.yml --attribution compliance/provenance/license-attribution.yml --strip-prefix j2f-export --out /tmp/j2f/report_license_full.json   # first run FAIL exit 1 (gpl-2.0-or-later self-reference) -> exact-atom attribution loop -> re-run PASS exit 0
